answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the raven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
